name: BASELINE
description: Canonical mixed fixed-tier design.
theoretical_role: Reference estimate for all paired condition-vs-baseline comparisons.

name: SHAM_AI_LABELS_FREE
description: Strict placebo: non-none labels are retained for grouping but all non-none tiers use no-AI behavior with no AI costs.
theoretical_role: If tier labels alone generate effects, the model is biased; effects should collapse toward zero.

name: NO_INFORMATION_ADVANTAGE_FREE
description: Paid tiers receive human-level information and domain capabilities, with AI costs removed.
theoretical_role: Separates information-processing advantage from residual tier-label behavior.

name: FREE_AI
description: AI subscription and usage costs are zero.
theoretical_role: Tests whether the frontier_ai result is a pricing artifact rather than a future-knowledge mechanism.

name: NO_AI_ERRORS
description: Remove hallucination and overconfidence penalties.
theoretical_role: Tests whether the paradox is reducible to AI mistakes rather than endogenous market response.

name: NO_CROWDING
description: Disable opportunity-level competition dynamics and convex crowding return dilution.
theoretical_role: Refutes the second-order crowding channel if frontier_ai penalties persist unchanged.

name: NO_RETURN_DILUTION
description: Set only the convex capital-saturation return-dilution term to zero; competition and recursion signals remain active.
theoretical_role: Distinguishes economic crowding losses from informational/behavioral convergence.

name: PERFORMATIVE_COMMON_025
description: Performative demand (ψ=0.25, common): effective niche capacity grows with lagged collective dollar commitment; the enlarged demand is shared by all founders in the niche.
theoretical_role: Tests whether the frontier deficit is an artifact of objective/fixed value by making demand endogenously performed by prior collective action; survival of the deficit shows the mechanism runs on capture under convergence, not on value being pre-given.

name: PERFORMATIVE_COMMON_050
description: Performative demand (ψ=0.50, common): effective niche capacity grows with lagged collective dollar commitment; the enlarged demand is shared by all founders in the niche.
theoretical_role: Dose-response for performed demand as a common good.

name: PERFORMATIVE_COMMON_100
description: Performative demand (ψ=1.00, common): effective niche capacity grows with lagged collective dollar commitment; the enlarged demand is shared by all founders in the niche.
theoretical_role: Upper-dose performed-demand common-good test; if the deficit only closes here, escape requires implausibly elastic performed demand.

name: PERFORMATIVE_APPROPRIABLE_025
description: Performative demand (ψ=0.25, appropriable): the demand uplift accrues to each founder in proportion to their own commitment share (category ownership).
theoretical_role: Tests whether performativity escapes the trap only when the performed demand is privately appropriable — the same appropriability condition the execution-moat results identify.

name: PERFORMATIVE_APPROPRIABLE_050
description: Performative demand (ψ=0.50, appropriable): the demand uplift accrues to each founder in proportion to their own commitment share (category ownership).
theoretical_role: Dose-response for appropriable performed demand.

name: PERFORMATIVE_APPROPRIABLE_100
description: Performative demand (ψ=1.00, appropriable): the demand uplift accrues to each founder in proportion to their own commitment share (category ownership).
theoretical_role: Upper-dose appropriable performed-demand test.

name: CROWDING_ACTION_HHI_BLEND
description: Previous payoff equation: add 0.30 times the market-wide action-category HHI to each opportunity's outstanding-capital load.
theoretical_role: Tests whether the pure I/K canonical result depends on excluding a market-wide action-concentration term from the local capacity constraint.

name: NO_CREATED_BONUS
description: Remove the created-opportunity scoring affinities (any-created x1.1, own-creation x1.2 -> both 1.0).
theoretical_role: Tests whether creation-channel convergence depends on the hard-coded scoring attraction to founder-created niches.

name: OPPORTUNITY_COMPONENT_FIT_ON
description: Attach knowledge-component requirements to opportunities so founder-specific component overlap creates within-sector fit, with no strategy-rule change.
theoretical_role: Isolates whether finer founder-opportunity fit disperses selection or attenuates the frontier deficit without bundling comparative-advantage strategy.

name: ENDOGENOUS_OPPORTUNITIES_ONLY
description: Disable background public-opportunity replenishment after initialization; exploration and successful innovation remain the only sources of new opportunities.
theoretical_role: Tests whether the result and open-futures dynamics depend on an exogenous continuing flow of market opportunities.

name: NICHE_MULTIPLICITY_ONE
description: Each successful exploration-created niche event opens exactly one opportunity instead of a uniform one-to-three draw.
theoretical_role: Lower-bound test for whether arbitrary niche multiplicity manufactures the opportunity-creation channel.

name: NICHE_MULTIPLICITY_FIXED_TWO
description: Each successful exploration-created niche event opens exactly two opportunities, preserving the baseline draw's mean while removing its variance.
theoretical_role: Tests whether stochastic multiplicity rather than endogenous creation drives the result.

name: NICHE_MULTIPLICITY_THREE
description: Each successful exploration-created niche event opens exactly three opportunities.
theoretical_role: Upper-bound dose test for the opportunity-creation multiplicity assumption.

name: NO_AI_HERDING_RECURSION
description: Suppress AI herding and AI action-correlation contributions to uncertainty recursion.
theoretical_role: Tests whether the paradox depends on shared AI signal convergence specifically.

name: CASH_ONLY_SURVIVAL
description: Legacy cash-on-hand survival rule: in-flight investment capital does not count toward solvency (counterfactual to the net-worth default).
theoretical_role: Isolates how much of the frontier survival gap is illiquidity (deployed-but-maturing capital) versus genuine insolvency.

name: LOW_CROWDING
description: Reduced opportunity-level competition accumulation and convex crowding strength.
theoretical_role: Sensitivity check for the market convergence/crowding mechanism.

name: HIGH_CROWDING
description: Increased opportunity-level competition accumulation and convex crowding strength.
theoretical_role: Stress test for whether second-order costs intensify under denser convergence.

name: AI_COST_2X
description: Double AI costs; bounds sensitivity to pricing assumptions.
theoretical_role: Tests whether cost pressure amplifies but does not solely create the paradox.

name: NO_RETURN_NOISE
description: Remove idiosyncratic execution noise on realized returns (RETURN_NOISE_SCALE=0); the opportunity-level Pareto draw remains.
theoretical_role: Tests whether the frontier trap depends on noise-under-threshold success classification rather than convergence; also removes the only channel decorrelating co-investor outcomes.

name: RETURN_NOISE_LOW
description: Halve idiosyncratic return noise (sigma=0.19, 0.5x default).
theoretical_role: Lower bracket of the execution-noise sensitivity sweep pending the venture-dispersion calibration pass.

name: RETURN_NOISE_HIGH
description: Increase idiosyncratic return noise by half (sigma=0.57, 1.5x default).
theoretical_role: Upper bracket of the execution-noise sensitivity sweep pending the venture-dispersion calibration pass.

name: NOVELTY_GENERALIZATION_STRESS_ON
description: Enable an explicit AI generalization stress on novel, data-poor, stealth, and endogenous opportunities.
theoretical_role: Tests a stronger agentic-novelty interpretation as a refutation/stress cell, not a baseline assumption.

name: FRONTIER_COVERAGE_MAX
description: Frontier AI sees maximal public opportunity coverage and breadth.
theoretical_role: Operationalizes AGI as near-complete access to public, data-rich opportunity evidence.

name: FRONTIER_REASONING_NO_ERROR
description: Frontier AI has near-perfect domain reasoning with zero hallucination in all AI domains.
theoretical_role: Operationalizes AGI as reliable reasoning/calibration rather than merely more visible opportunities.

name: FRONTIER_PUBLIC_OMNISCIENCE
description: Frontier AI receives maximal public coverage, near-perfect domain reasoning, and large quality boosts.
theoretical_role: Near-omniscience counterfactual for public-information access.

name: FRONTIER_EXEC_5X
description: Frontier AI receives 5x investment execution success multiplier.
theoretical_role: Tests whether execution dominance can overcome second-order future-knowledge costs.

name: FRONTIER_EXEC_1_5X
description: Frontier AI receives 1.5x investment execution success multiplier.
theoretical_role: Defensibility dose-response (P19): how strong must an isolating mechanism be to escape the trap?

name: FRONTIER_EXEC_2X
description: Frontier AI receives 2x investment execution success multiplier.
theoretical_role: Defensibility dose-response (P19).

name: FRONTIER_EXEC_3X
description: Frontier AI receives 3x investment execution success multiplier.
theoretical_role: Defensibility dose-response (P19).

name: TRUNCATED_TAIL
description: Conservative robustness: remove the canonical niche-size tail and retain truncated opportunity-return caps.
theoretical_role: P20: the no-size-tail distribution is the conservative case; the trap should persist.

name: MODERATE_TAIL
description: Intermediate canonical tail: niche-size log-sigma halfway between truncated and baseline; return-tail settings retained for option-B comparisons.
theoretical_role: P20: tail dose-response; the trap is robust across market-size tail weight.

name: OPS_COST_060
description: Operating-cost level 0.60 (lower; higher aggregate survival).
theoretical_role: P21: the frontier deficit is invariant to where in the venture-class band the cost anchor sits.

name: OPS_COST_075
description: Operating-cost level 0.75 (between the low-cost stress and the calibrated 0.85 baseline).
theoretical_role: P21 cost-calibration invariance.

name: OPS_COST_100
description: Operating-cost level 1.00 (default; lower aggregate survival).
theoretical_role: P21 cost-calibration invariance.

name: FRONTIER_QUALITY_PLUS50
description: Frontier AI receives +50pp innovation quality and information-quality boost.
theoretical_role: Tests an AGI-as-output-quality interpretation rather than an AGI-as-market-convergence interpretation.

name: ALL_FAVORABLE_TO_FRONTIER
description: Extreme pro-frontier cell: no AI cost/error/crowding/novelty penalty plus execution and quality boosts.
theoretical_role: Sanity check that the model can reverse under an intentionally pro-frontier world.

name: STRATEGIC_ANTICIPATION_ON
description: Enable AI-assisted anticipation of crowded shared signals.
theoretical_role: Independent-implementation robustness check for the canonical S1 strategy-ladder operationalization.

name: STRATEGIC_DIVERSIFICATION_ON
description: Enable anticipation plus equilibrium-aware diversification across near-top opportunities.
theoretical_role: Independent-implementation robustness check for the canonical S1 strategy-ladder operationalization.

name: AI_COMPLEMENTARITY_ON
description: AI accuracy depends on agent traits and sector knowledge.
theoretical_role: Operationalizes AGI as a complement to entrepreneurial judgment rather than a substitute.

name: SUBSCRIPTION_ERA
description: Subscription-era pricing: monthly seat fees ($400 advanced / $3,500 frontier) plus metered usage, replacing the pure usage-based default.
theoretical_role: Tests whether the frontier result depends on the marginal-compute pricing default rather than a subscription-plus-usage pricing architecture.

name: DIFFICULTY_SCALED_AI_COST
description: AI call costs scale with opportunity complexity.
theoretical_role: Tests whether frontier AGI is differentially exposed to expensive reasoning on hard opportunities.

name: MARKET_SLACK_HIGH_CAPACITY
description: Opportunity capacity is high and crowding is weaker.
theoretical_role: Boundary condition: paradox should weaken when market slack absorbs convergent investment.

name: CAPACITY_MEAN_HALF
description: Halve mean opportunity capacity while holding the oversubscription threshold, penalty strength, convexity, and capacity-tail dispersion fixed.
theoretical_role: One-factor identification: tests whether the dollar capacity scale alone creates the tier contrast.

name: CAPACITY_MEAN_DOUBLE
description: Double mean opportunity capacity while holding the oversubscription threshold, penalty strength, convexity, and capacity-tail dispersion fixed.
theoretical_role: One-factor identification: tests whether the dollar capacity scale alone creates the tier contrast.

name: CAPACITY_AWARE_SELECTION
description: Agents fully discount the currently observable opportunity-specific I/K penalty when ranking opportunities; contemporaneous rival commitments remain unobserved.
theoretical_role: Tests whether capacity losses require strategically naive founders rather than simultaneous convergence on opportunities that looked unsaturated at commitment.

name: MARKET_DENSE_LOW_CAPACITY
description: Opportunity capacity is low and crowding is stronger.
theoretical_role: Boundary condition: paradox should strengthen when opportunity spaces saturate quickly.

name: OPPORTUNITY_RICH_ENVIRONMENT
description: More initial opportunities and higher discovery probability.
theoretical_role: Boundary condition: broad opportunity supply should reduce convergence pressure.

name: OPPORTUNITY_SPARSE_ENVIRONMENT
description: Fewer initial opportunities and lower discovery probability.
theoretical_role: Boundary condition: scarce opportunity supply should amplify convergence pressure.

name: EQUAL_SECTORS
description: Even 25/25/25/25 split across the four sectors, replacing the NVCA-weighted 60% tech baseline.
theoretical_role: Sector-composition robustness: if the deficit is an artifact of the tech-heavy weighting, a balanced population should eliminate it; we predict it attenuates but persists, because crowding operates within every sector.

name: SERVICES_HEAVY
description: Low-tech population dominated by services and retail (service 45 / retail 25 / manufacturing 20 / tech 10).
theoretical_role: Opposite extreme from the tech-heavy baseline: the high-competition, heavy-tail tech sector is where convergence bites hardest, so a services-heavy mix should show the smallest deficit; a deficit that survives here shows the paradox is not a tech-sector artifact.

name: EMERGENT_ADOPTION_BASELINE
description: Agents start without AI and choose tiers endogenously.
theoretical_role: Generalizability check against fixed equal-tier assignment.

name: FRONTIER_STRATEGY_CONSENSUS
description: Frontier-tier agents anticipate consensus congestion (S1): expected returns of consensus-legible opportunities shaded before commitment.
theoretical_role: Congestion channel: tests whether the frontier deficit shrinks when frontier users discount opportunities that many rivals' instruments also rank highly.

name: FRONTIER_STRATEGY_COMPARATIVE
description: Frontier-tier agents re-rank by private edge (S2): sector familiarity, knowledge overlap, and execution traits weight the AI's landscape map.
theoretical_role: Heterogeneity channel: tests whether founder-market fit adds dispersive information beyond the AI landscape map.

name: FRONTIER_STRATEGY_COMPLEMENT
description: Frontier-tier agents seek complements (S3): explore/innovate effort shifts toward opportunities where their own instrument reports low confidence.
theoretical_role: Trap attenuation, codifiability-frontier channel (Hayek/effectuation): building where shared models add least should reduce convergent entry.

name: FRONTIER_STRATEGY_COMPOSITE
description: Frontier-tier agents run S1+S2+S3 jointly (agi_native).
theoretical_role: Frontier adaptivity composite: tests whether S1+S2+S3 together recover relative advantage beyond the FREE_AI bound.

name: ALL_STRATEGY_CONSENSUS
description: Every agent anticipates consensus congestion (S1), regardless of tier.
theoretical_role: Reflexivity relocation test: when contrarianism is widespread, does crowding relocate into formerly neglected opportunities or decline?

name: ALL_STRATEGY_COMPARATIVE
description: Every agent re-ranks by private edge (S2), regardless of tier.
theoretical_role: Reflexivity relocation test: symmetric founder-market-fit sorting should disperse entry along heterogeneous edges; P5 predicts the survival value of the strategy still rises with tier.

name: ALL_STRATEGY_COMPARATIVE_COMPONENTS
description: Every agent re-ranks by private edge (S2) using PER-OPPORTUNITY knowledge-component overlap (ENABLE_OPPORTUNITY_COMPONENTS), not the coarse sector-familiarity fallback.
theoretical_role: Tests whether within-sector founder-market fit (recombinant-knowledge overlap, gate ~0.55) adds dispersion beyond sector-familiarity S2.

name: ALL_STRATEGY_COMPLEMENT
description: Every agent seeks complements (S3), regardless of tier.
theoretical_role: Reflexivity relocation test: if everyone targets oracle-blind opportunities, second-order crowding should emerge in low-legibility niches (P4's signature).

name: ALL_STRATEGY_COMPOSITE
description: Every agent runs S1+S2+S3 jointly (agi_native), regardless of tier.
theoretical_role: Population-wide strategy test: does the paradox of future knowledge survive symmetric AGI-native strategy, or does reflexivity attenuate under symmetric sophistication?

name: OPEN_ACTION_PIVOT
description: Abandonment option (A1): agents review in-flight investments each round and may liquidate at an age-dependent haircut (0.40 → 0.75 of committed capital), redeploying the recovery. Deterioration gain 2.0 per liveness probe (scripts/probe_pivot_liveness.jl).
theoretical_role: Pivot-channel test: measures whether escape from crowded commitments attenuates the trap and whether pivots re-correlate onto consensus second-best opportunities.

name: OPEN_ACTION_DIRECTED_CREATION
description: Hayekian redirection (A2): innovating agents bias new-combination sector selection away from sectors they perceive as crowded toward sparse ones; creation volume is unchanged.
theoretical_role: Directed-creation test: measures whether steering new combinations toward sparse sectors raises supply elasticity and attenuates convergence pressure.

name: OPEN_ACTION_BOTH
description: Both open-action channels (A1 pivot + A2 directed creation) active for all agents. Pivot deterioration gain 2.0 per liveness probe.
theoretical_role: P6 + P7 jointly: the full open-action space without strategic sophistication — does opening exit AND entry topology together leave the trap standing where each channel alone does?

name: OPEN_ACTION_AGI_NATIVE_MARKET
description: Maximal AGI-robustness cell: open action space (pivot + directed creation, pivot gain 2.0 per liveness probe) with every agent running the composite AGI-native strategy.
theoretical_role: Joint open-action and strategy test: measures whether the paradox survives both open action spaces and population-wide strategic sophistication.

name: DOSE_S1_FRONTIER_2X
description: Dose probe: S1 raw consensus discount 2.0, frontier-only. The use-site clamp [0,1] (strategy_shaded_return) neutralizes this to an effective 1.0 — i.e. the documented default. Under paired seeds this cell should be bit-identical to FRONTIER_STRATEGY_CONSENSUS; any divergence would flag a saturation mismatch.
theoretical_role: Dose-response: verifies that the S1 default is already the maximum effective dose under the use-site clamp.

name: DOSE_S1_FRONTIER_MAXX
description: Dose ceiling: S1 consensus discount 1.0, frontier-only — the maximum value NOT clamp-neutralized (use-site clamp [0,1]), which equals the conservative default already run. Together with the 2X probe this pins the S1 dose-response curve as saturated from the start.
theoretical_role: Dose-response: bounds the S1 attenuation curve at the maximum expressible anticipatory-congestion discount.

name: DOSE_S2_FRONTIER_2X
description: Dose: S2 edge weight 2.0, frontier-only — the use-site clamp ceiling [0,2] (strategy_score_multiplier), i.e. the maximum effective S2 dose, doubling the founder-market-fit re-ranking gradient vs the default 1.0. (The overall [0.25,2.0] multiplier clamp additionally binds when |edge − mean edge| > 0.5.)
theoretical_role: Dose-response: bounds the S2 attenuation curve at its private-edge re-ranking ceiling.

name: DOSE_COMPOSITE_FRONTIER_MAX
description: Maximal-dose composite (agi_native), frontier-only: consensus discount 1.0 (S1 already saturated at its [0,1] clamp ceiling), edge weight 2.0 ([0,2] ceiling), complement shift 2.0 (S3a [0,2] ceiling; the S3b softening path clamps strength to [0,1] and stays at its saturated default). The strongest frontier-only strategy treatment the implementation can express.
theoretical_role: Dose-response: tests the strongest frontier-only composite strategy treatment expressible by the implementation.

name: DOSE_COMPOSITE_ALL_MAX
description: Maximal-dose composite (agi_native) for every tier: population-wide S1+S2+S3 at max-effective strengths (discount 1.0 / edge weight 2.0 / complement shift 2.0 — the use-site clamp ceilings).
theoretical_role: Dose-response analogue of P4 at the dial ceilings: does symmetric maximal sophistication retire the trap, relocate it, or leave it standing where defaults did neither? Bounds the population-wide attenuation curve.

name: DOSE_PIVOT_GAIN_4X
description: Abandonment option at deterioration gain 4.0. Gain is validated >= 0 and unbounded above; the trigger d_eff = clamp(deterioration x conviction x gain, 0, 1).
theoretical_role: Dose-response for the pivot channel: locates how higher pivot sensitivity changes exit behavior and trap attenuation at production scale.

name: DOSE_PIVOT_GAIN_8X
description: Abandonment option at deterioration gain 8.0; d_eff saturates (=1) whenever deterioration x conviction >= 0.125, an aggressive upper anchor for the liveness curve.
theoretical_role: Dose-response upper anchor for the pivot channel: tests whether making the trigger region highly reachable changes trap attenuation; pivot re-correlation onto consensus second-bests is reported either way.

name: DOSE_OPEN_COMPOSITE_MAX
description: Maximal-dose open-action cell: pivot at gain 8.0 + directed creation at default mixture strength + population-wide agi_native at max-effective strengths (discount 1.0 / edge 2.0 / shift 2.0).
theoretical_role: Dose-response ceiling for the joint open-action and strategy treatment.

name: AI_ERRORS_CORR_50
description: Half-shared AI estimate errors (AI_ERROR_CORRELATION rho=0.5): the continuous return-estimate error is sqrt(0.5)*eps_common(opp, round, tier) + sqrt(0.5)*eps_idio, total variance preserved — estimate accuracy is unchanged by construction; only cross-agent error commonality within a tier rises.
theoretical_role: Quality-vs-commonality decomposition: at fixed accuracy, tests whether the frontier treatment effect changes with shared signal error.

name: SHARED_AI_ERRORS
description: Fully shared AI estimate errors (AI_ERROR_CORRELATION rho=1.0): every same-tier agent's instrument draws THE SAME standard-normal error per (opportunity, round, tier) — the shared-foundation-model world with correlated blind spots — at exactly the per-agent error variance (accuracy) of the rho=0 default.
theoretical_role: Quality-vs-commonality endpoint: tests whether fully shared signal error deepens convergence at unchanged per-agent accuracy.

name: DECISION_NOISE_HIGH
description: Decision temperature doubled (DECISION_TEMPERATURE T=2.0): action-selection softmax utilities divided by 2x the calibrated temperature, flattening every agent's invest/innovate/explore/maintain mix toward uniform.
theoretical_role: Decision-mixing test: raising T flattens action probabilities and measures whether mixed action selection attenuates convergent entry.

name: DECISION_NOISE_LOW
description: Decision temperature halved (DECISION_TEMPERATURE T=0.5): action-selection softmax sharpened toward argmax — agents act nearly deterministically on their utilities.
theoretical_role: Deterministic-action bracket: lowering T sharpens action probabilities and pairs with DECISION_NOISE_HIGH to bound decision-mixing effects.
